paragraphs.en: The recent successes of generative AI models have convinced some that AGI is imminent. While these models appear to capture the essence of human intelligence, they defy even our most basic intuitions about it. They have emerged not because they are thoughtful solutions to the problem of intelligence, but because they scaled effectively on hardware we already had . Seduced by the fruits of scale, some have come to believe that it provides a clear pathway to AGI. The most emblematic case of this is the multimodal approach, in which massive modular networks are optimized for an array of modalities that, taken together, appear general. However, I argue that this strategy is sure to fail in the near term; it will not lead to human-level AGI that can, e.g., perform sensorimotor reasoning, motion planning, and social coordination. Instead of trying to glue modalities together into a patchwork AGI, we should pursue approaches to intelligence that treat embodiment and interaction with the environment as primary , and see modality-centered processing as emergent phenomena.

paragraphs.en: Preface: Disembodied definitions of Artificial General Intelligence — emphasis on general — exclude crucial problem spaces that we should expect AGI to be able to solve. A true AGI must be general across all domains. Any complete definition must at least include the ability to solve problems that originate in physical reality, e.g. repairing a car, untying a knot, preparing food, etc. As I will discuss in the next section, what is needed for these problems is a form of intelligence that is fundamentally situated in something like a physical world model . For more discussion on this, look out for Designing an Intelligence . Edited by George Konidaris, MIT Press, forthcoming.
paragraphs.zh: 前言：对通用人工智能（AGI）的非具身定义——重点在“通用”——排除了一些我们理应期待AGI能够解决的关键问题空间。 真正的AGI必须在所有领域都具有通用性。 任何完整的定义都必须至少包含解决源于物理现实的问题的能力，例如修理汽车、解开绳结、准备食物等。 正如我将在下一节讨论的，解决这些问题所需的是一种从根本上植根于某种物理世界模型的智能形式。 关于这一点的更多讨论，请关注《设计一种智能》（Designing an Intelligence）。 乔治·科尼达里斯（George Konidaris）编辑，麻省理工学院出版社，即将出版。

paragraphs.en: TLDR: I first argue that true AGI needs a physical understanding of the world , as many problems cannot be converted into a problem of symbol manipulation . It has been suggested by some that LLMs are learning a model of the world through next token prediction, but it is more likely that LLMs are learning bags of heuristics to predict tokens. This leaves them with a superficial understanding of reality and contributes to false impressions of their intelligence.
paragraphs.zh: 简而言之：我首先论证真正的 AGI 需要对物理世界的理解，因为许多问题无法被转化为符号操作的问题。 有人认为大语言模型正在通过预测下一个词来学习世界模型，但更可能的是，大语言模型学到的是一堆用于预测词的启发式方法的集合。 这使得它们对现实只有肤浅的理解，并造成了对其智能的虚假印象。

paragraphs.en: The most shocking result of the predict-next-token objective is that it yields AI models that reflect a deeply human-like understanding of the world, despite having never observed it like we have. This result has led to confusion about what it means to understand language and even to understand the world — something we have long believed to be a prerequisite for language understanding. One explanation for the capabilities of LLMs comes from an emerging theory suggesting that they induce models of the world through next-token prediction . Proponents of this theory cite the prowess of SOTA LLMs on various benchmarks, the convergence of large models to similar internal representations , and their favorite rendition of the idea that “language mirrors the structure of reality,” a notion that has been espoused at least by Plato, Wittgenstein, Foucault, and Eco. While I’m generally in support of digging up esoteric texts for research inspiration, I’m worried that this metaphor has been taken too literally. Do LLMs really learn implicit models of the world? How could they otherwise be so proficient at language?
paragraphs.zh: 预测下一个词（predict-next-token）这一目标最令人震惊的结果是，它所训练出的 AI 模型展现出与人类高度相似的对世界的深刻理解，尽管它们从未像我们那样观察过世界。 这一结果引发了困惑：理解语言意味着什么？理解世界又意味着什么——而我们长期以来一直认为，理解世界是理解语言的前提。 对大语言模型（LLM）能力的一种解释来自一个新兴理论，该理论认为它们通过预测下一个词（next-token prediction）归纳出世界模型。 这一理论的支持者引用了最先进（SOTA）大语言模型在各类基准测试中的卓越表现、大型模型收敛到相似内部表示的现象，以及他们最钟爱的那句“语言映照现实结构”的表述——这一观念至少曾被柏拉图、维特根斯坦、福柯和艾柯所倡导。 尽管我总体上支持从深奥的古籍中挖掘研究灵感，但我担心这个隐喻被过于字面化地理解了。 大语言模型真的学到了隐式的世界模型吗？ 否则它们怎能在语言上如此娴熟？

paragraphs.en: One source of evidence in favor of the LLM world modeling hypothesis is the Othello paper , wherein researchers were able to predict the board of an Othello game from the hidden states of a transformer model trained on sequences of legal moves . However, there are many issues with generalizing these results to models of natural language. For one, whereas Othello moves can provably be used to deduce the full state of an Othello board, we have no reason to believe that a complete picture of the physical world can be inferred by a linguistic description. What sets the game of Othello apart from many tasks in the physical world is that Othello fundamentally resides in the land of symbols, and is merely implemented using physical tokens to make it easier for humans to play. A full game of Othello can be played with just pen and paper, but one can’t, e.g., sweep a floor, do dishes, or drive a car with just pen and paper. To solve such tasks, you need some physical conception of the world beyond what humans can merely say about it. Whether that conception of the world is encoded in a formal world model or, e.g., a value function is up for debate, but it is clear that there are many problems in the physical world that cannot be fully represented by a system of symbols and solved with mere symbol manipulation.
paragraphs.zh: 支持 LLM 世界建模假说的一个证据来源是 Othello 论文，研究者能够从在合法落子序列上训练的 transformer 模型的隐藏状态中预测黑白棋对局的棋盘状态。 然而，将这些结果推广到自然语言模型存在许多问题。 一方面，虽然可以证明黑白棋的落子能够用来推导出棋盘的完整状态，但我们没有理由认为语言描述能够推断出物理世界的完整图景。 黑白棋与物理世界中许多任务的不同之处在于，黑白棋从根本上属于符号的世界，只是用实体棋子来实现它，以方便人类游玩。 一局完整的黑白棋只需纸笔就能进行，但人们无法只用纸笔来扫地、洗碗或开车。 要解决这类任务，你需要对世界的某种物理层面的理解，它超出了人类仅仅用语言所能表达的内容。 这种对世界的理解究竟是以形式化世界模型的形式编码，还是以价值函数等形式编码，尚存争议，但显而易见的是，物理世界中有许多问题无法仅靠符号系统来完整表示，也无法仅靠符号操作来解决。

paragraphs.en: Another issue stated in Melanie Mitchell’s recent piece and supported by this paper , is that there is evidence that generative models can score remarkably well on sequence prediction tasks while failing to learn models of the worlds that created such sequence data , e.g. by learning comprehensive sets of idiosyncratic heuristics. E.g., it was pointed out in this blog post that OthelloGPT learned sequence prediction rules that don’t actually hold for all possible Othello games, like “if the token for B4 does not appear before A4 in the input string, then B4 is empty.” While one can argue that it doesn’t matter how a world model predicts the next state of the world, it should raise suspicion when that prediction reflects a better understanding of the training data than the underlying world that led to such data. This, unfortunately, is the central fault of the predict-next-token objective, which seeks only to retain information relevant to the prediction of the next token. If it can be done with something easier to learn than a world model, it likely will be.
paragraphs.zh: Melanie Mitchell 在近期文章中提出、并得到本文支持的另一个问题是：有证据表明，生成式模型可以在序列预测任务上取得相当高的分数，却未能学习到产生这些序列数据的世界的模型，例如通过学习一套全面的、特异性的启发式规则。 例如，有博客文章指出，OthelloGPT 学到的序列预测规则并不真正适用于所有可能的双陆棋（Othello）对局，比如「如果表示 B4 的 token 在输入字符串中没有出现在 A4 之前，那么 B4 就是空的」。虽然人们可以争论说世界模型如何预测世界的下一个状态并不重要，但当这种预测反映出它对训练数据的理解好于对产生这些数据的底层世界的理解时，就应该引起怀疑。 遗憾的是，这正是「预测下一个 token」目标的核心缺陷，它只寻求保留与预测下一个 token 相关的信息。 如果用比世界模型更容易学习的东西就能做到，那很可能就会这样做。

paragraphs.en: To claim without caveat that predicting the effects of earlier symbols on later symbols requires a model of the world like the ones humans generate from perception would be to abuse the “world model” notion . Unless we disagree on what the world is, it should be clear that a true world model can be used to predict the next state of the physical world given a history of states. Similar world models, which predict high fidelity observations of the physical world, are leveraged in many subfields of AI including model-based reinforcement learning , task and motion planning in robotics , causal world modeling , and areas of computer vision to solve problems instantiated in physical reality. LLMs are simply not running physics simulations in their latent next-token calculus when they ask you if your person, place, or thing is bigger than a breadbox. In fact, I conjecture that the behavior of LLMs is not thanks to a learned world model, but to brute force memorization of incomprehensibly abstract rules governing the behavior of symbols, i.e. a model of syntax .
paragraphs.zh: 若毫无保留地断言「预测较早符号对较晚符号的影响需要一个如同人类从感知中生成的世界模型」，将是对「世界模型」这一概念的滥用。 除非我们对「世界是什么」存在分歧，否则应当清楚：一个真正的世界模型可以用来在给定状态历史的条件下预测物理世界的下一个状态。 类似的、能够对物理世界进行高保真预测的世界模型，被应用于人工智能的许多子领域，包括基于模型的强化学习、机器人学中的任务与运动规划、因果世界建模，以及计算机视觉中的若干方向，以求解在物理现实中实例化的问题。 当大语言模型问你所想的人、地点或物品是否比一个面包盒更大时，它们并没有在其潜在的下一个词元演算中运行物理仿真。 事实上，我推测大语言模型的行为并非得益于一个学习到的世界模型，而是得益于对那些支配符号行为的、难以理解的抽象规则的暴力式记忆，即一个句法模型。

sents.en: LLMs are simply not running physics simulations in their latent next-token calculus when they ask you if your person, place, or thing is bigger than a breadbox.

paragraphs.en: Without getting too technical, there is intuitive evidence that somewhat separate systems of cognition are responsible for each of these linguistic faculties. Look no further than the capability for humans to generate syntactically well-formed sentences that have no semantic meaning, e.g. Chomsky’s famous sentence “Colorless green ideas sleep furiously,” or sentences with well-formed semantics that make no pragmatic sense, e.g. responding merely with “Yes, I can” when asked, “Can you pass the salt?” Crucially, it is the fusion of the disparate cognitive abilities underpinning them that coalesce into human language understanding. For example, there isn’t anything syntactically wrong with the sentence, “The fridge is in the apple,” as a syntactic account of “the fridge” and “the apple” would categorize them as noun phrases that can be used to produce a sentence with the production rule, S → (NP “is in” NP). However, humans recognize an obvious semantic failure in the sentence that becomes apparent after attempting to reconcile its meaning with our understanding of reality : we know that fridges are larger than apples, and could not be fit into them.
paragraphs.zh: 不必过于技术化地讨论，就有直观的证据表明，这些语言能力各自由多少有些独立的认知系统负责。 只需看看以下现象即可：人类能够生成语法上合式却没有语义意义的句子，例如 乔姆斯基的著名句子「无色的绿色想法愤怒地沉睡」，或者语义合式却没有语用意义的句子，例如在被问到「你能把盐递给我吗？」时仅仅回答「是的，我能」。关键在于，正是支撑这些能力的不同认知能力融合在一起，才形成了人类对语言的理解。 例如，「冰箱在苹果里」这句话在句法上没有任何问题，因为从句法角度分析，「the fridge」和「the apple」会被归类为名词短语，可以运用生成规则 S →（NP「is in」NP）来造出一个句子。 然而，人类能在这句话中察觉到明显的语义错误，当我们试图把它的含义与我们 对现实的理解相调和时，这种错误便显现出来：我们知道冰箱比苹果大得多，不可能装进苹果里。

paragraphs.en: Finding that LLMs have reduced problems of semantics and pragmatics into syntax would have profound implications on how we should view their intelligence. People often treat language proficiency as a proxy for general intelligence by, e.g., strongly associating pragmatic and semantic understanding with the cognitive abilities that undergird them in humans. For example, someone who appears well-read and graceful in navigating social interactions is likely to score high in traits like sustained attention and theory of mind, which lie closer to measures of raw cognitive ability. In general, these proxies are reasonable for assessing a person’s general intelligence, but not an LLM’s, as the apparent linguistic skills of LLMs could come from entirely separate mechanisms of cognition.
paragraphs.zh: 如果发现大语言模型把语义和语用问题化约为句法问题，这将对我们如何看待它们的智能产生深远的影响。 人们常常把语言能力当作通用智能的替代指标，例如，强烈地把语用和语义理解与人类中支撑这些能力的认知能力联系起来。 例如，一个在社交互动中显得博学且得体的人，很可能在持续性注意力和心智理论等特质上得分很高，而这些特质更接近于对原始认知能力的衡量。 总的来说，这些替代指标用于评估一个人的通用智能是合理的，但不适用于评估大语言模型，因为大语言模型表面上展现的语言技能可能来自完全不同的认知机制。

paragraphs.en: TLDR: Sutton’s Bitter Lesson has sometimes been interpreted as meaning that making any assumptions about the structure of AI is a mistake. This is both unproductive and a misinterpretation; it is precisely when humans think deeply about the structure of intelligence that major advancements occur. Despite this, scale maximalists have implicitly suggested that multimodal models can be a structure-agnostic framework for AGI. Ironically, today’s multimodal models contradict Sutton’s Bitter Lesson by making implicit assumptions about the structure of individual modalities and how they should be sewn together. In order to build AGI, we must either think deeply about how to unite existing modalities, or dispense with them altogether in favor of an interactive and embodied cognitive process.
paragraphs.zh: 简而言之：Sutton 的「苦涩教训」有时被解读为：对人工智能的结构做任何假设都是一个错误。 这种解读既无益也不正确；恰恰是在人类深入思考智能的结构时，才会发生重大进展。 尽管如此，规模至上主义者们仍含蓄地表示，多模态模型可以成为一个不依赖结构的通用人工智能（AGI）框架。 具有讽刺意味的是，如今的多模态模型恰恰违背了 Sutton 的「苦涩教训」：它们对各个模态的结构以及这些模态应如何被缝合在一起做出了隐含假设。 为了构建 AGI，我们必须么深入思考如何统一现有模态，么彻底摒弃它们，转而采用一种交互式、具身的认知过程。

paragraphs.en: The paradigm that led to the success of LLMs is marked primarily by scale , not efficiency. We have effectively trained a pile of one trillion ants for one billion years to mimic the form and function of a Formula 1 race car; eventually it gets there, but wow was the process inefficient. This analogy nicely captures a debate between structuralists, who want to build things like "wheels" and "axles" into AI systems, and scale maximalists, who want more ants, years, and F1 races to train on. Despite many decades of structuralist study in linguistics, the unstructured approaches of scale maximalism have yielded far better ant-racecars in recent years. This was most notably articulated by Rich Sutton — a recent recipient of the Turing Award along with Andy Barto for their work in Reinforcement Learning — in his piece “The Bitter Lesson.”
paragraphs.zh: 带来大语言模型成功的范式主要标志是规模，而非效率。 我们实际上相当于训练了一万亿只蚂蚁十亿年，去模仿一级方程式赛车的形态与功能；最终它做到了，但这一过程实在低效得惊人。 这个比喻很好地概括了一场争论：结构主义者想把“轮子”和“车轴”之类的东西构建到人工智能系统中，而规模至上主义者则想要更多的蚂蚁、更多的年份和更多的一级方程式比赛来训练。 尽管语言学中结构主义研究已有数十年历史，但近年来规模至上主义的非结构化方法却造出了远为出色的蚂蚁赛车。 这一点最著名的阐述来自 Rich Sutton——他因在强化学习方面的工作与 Andy Barto 最近共同获得图灵奖——见其文章《苦涩的教训》（The Bitter Lesson）。

paragraphs.en: Sutton’s argument is that methods that leverage computational resources will outpace methods that do not, and that any structure for problem-solving built as an inductive bias into AI will hinder it from learning better solutions. This is a compelling argument that I believe has been seriously misinterpreted by some as implying that making any assumptions about structure is a false step. It is, in fact, human intuition that was responsible for many significant advancements in the development of SOTA neural network architectures. For example, Convolutional Neural Networks made an assumption about translation invariance for pattern recognition in images and kickstarted the modern field of deep learning for computer vision; the attention mechanism of Transformers made an assumption about the long-distance relationships between symbols in a sentence that made ChatGPT possible and had nearly everyone drop their RNNs; and 3D Gaussian Splatting made an assumption about the solidity of physical objects that made it more performant than NeRFs. Potentially none of these methodological assumptions apply to the entire domain of possible scenes, images, or token streams, but they do for the specific ones that humans have curated and formed structural intuitions about. Let’s not forget that humans have co-evolved with the environments that these datasets are drawn from.
paragraphs.zh: Sutton 的论点是：利用计算资源的方法将超越不利用计算资源的方法，而任何作为归纳偏置内建于 AI 的问题求解结构都会阻碍它学习更好的解决方案。 这是一个很有说服力的论点，但我认为它被一些人严重误读，似乎在暗示对结构做任何假设都是错误的一步。 事实上，正是人类直觉促成了 SOTA 神经网络架构发展中的许多重大进步。 例如，卷积神经网络对图像中模式识别的平移不变性做出了假设，从而开创了现代计算机视觉深度学习领域；Transformer 的注意力机制对句子中符号之间的长距离关系做出了假设，使 ChatGPT 成为可能，并让几乎所有人都放弃了 RNN；3D 高斯泼溅对物理对象的实体性做出了假设，使其性能超越了 NeRF。 这些方法学上的假设可能都不适用于所有可能的场景、图像或 token 流的整体领域，但它们确实适用于那些人类已加以整理并形成结构性直觉的特定对象。 我们不要忘记，人类是与这些数据集所源自的环境共同演化的。

sents.en: Sutton’s argument is that methods that leverage computational resources will outpace methods that do not, and that any structure for problem-solving built as an inductive bias into AI will hinder it from learning better solutions.
sents.zh: Sutton 的论点是：利用计算资源的方法将超越不利用计算资源的方法，而任何作为归纳偏置内建于 AI 的问题求解结构都会阻碍它学习更好的解决方案。

sents.en: This is a compelling argument that I believe has been seriously misinterpreted by some as implying that making any assumptions about structure is a false step.
sents.zh: 这是一个很有说服力的论点，但我认为它被一些人严重误读，似乎在暗示对结构做任何假设都是错误的一步。

sents.en: It is, in fact, human intuition that was responsible for many significant advancements in the development of SOTA neural network architectures.
sents.zh: 事实上，正是人类直觉促成了 SOTA 神经网络架构发展中的许多重大进步。

sents.en: For example, Convolutional Neural Networks made an assumption about translation invariance for pattern recognition in images and kickstarted the modern field of deep learning for computer vision; the attention mechanism of Transformers made an assumption about the long-distance relationships between symbols in a sentence that made ChatGPT possible and had nearly everyone drop their RNNs; and 3D Gaussian Splatting made an assumption about the solidity of physical objects that made it more performant than NeRFs.
sents.zh: 例如，卷积神经网络对图像中模式识别的平移不变性做出了假设，从而开创了现代计算机视觉深度学习领域；Transformer 的注意力机制对句子中符号之间的长距离关系做出了假设，使 ChatGPT 成为可能，并让几乎所有人都放弃了 RNN；3D 高斯泼溅对物理对象的实体性做出了假设，使其性能超越了 NeRF。

sents.en: Potentially none of these methodological assumptions apply to the entire domain of possible scenes, images, or token streams, but they do for the specific ones that humans have curated and formed structural intuitions about.
sents.zh: 这些方法学上的假设可能都不适用于所有可能的场景、图像或 token 流的整体领域，但它们确实适用于那些人类已加以整理并形成结构性直觉的特定对象。

sents.en: Let’s not forget that humans have co-evolved with the environments that these datasets are drawn from.
sents.zh: 我们不要忘记，人类是与这些数据集所源自的环境共同演化的。

paragraphs.en: The real question is how we might heed Sutton’s Bitter Lesson in our development of AGI. The scale maximalist approach worked for LLMs and LVMs (large vision models) because we had natural deposits of text and image data, but an analogous application of scale maximalism to AGI would require forms of embodiment data that we simply don’t have. One solution to this data scarcity issue extends the generative modeling paradigm to multimodal modeling — encompassing language, vision, and action — with the hope that a general intelligence can be built by summing together general models of narrow modalities.
paragraphs.zh: 真正的问题在于，我们在开发 AGI 的过程中该如何借鉴 Sutton 的苦涩教训。 规模至上主义路线在大型语言模型和大型视觉模型上之所以奏效，是因为我们拥有文本和图像数据的天然矿藏，但将规模至上主义类似地应用于 AGI，则需要某种具身数据，而我们根本没有这样的数据储备。 解决这种数据稀缺问题的一个方案，是将生成式建模范式扩展到多模态建模——涵盖语言、视觉与动作——并寄希望于把各窄模态的通用模型叠加起来，就能构建出通用智能。

sents.zh: 真正的问题在于，我们在开发 AGI 的过程中该如何借鉴 Sutton 的苦涩教训。

paragraphs.en: There are multiple issues with this approach. First, there are deep connections between modalities that are unnaturally severed in the multimodal setting , making the problem of concept synthesis ever more difficult. In practice, uniting modalities often involves pre-training dedicated neural modules for each modality and joining them together into a joint embedding space. In the early days, this was achieved by nudging the embeddings of, e.g. (language, vision, action) tuples to converge to similar latent vectors of meaning, a vast oversimplification of the kinds of relationships that may exist between modalities. One can imagine, e.g., captioning an image at various levels of abstraction, or implementing the same linguistic instruction with different sets of physical actions. Such one-to-many relationships suggest that a contrastive embedding objective is not suitable.
paragraphs.zh: 这种方法存在多个问题。 首先，各模态之间存在深层的联系，而在多模态设定中这些联系被不自然地割裂，使概念合成的问题变得更加困难。 在实践中，统一各模态通常涉及为每个模态预训练专用的神经模块，并将它们连接到一个联合嵌入空间中。 在早期，这是通过微调例如 （语言、视觉、动作）元组的嵌入，使其收敛到相似的潜在意义向量来实现的，这是对模态之间可能存在的各种关系的一种极度简化。 可以想象，例如，以不同的抽象层次为一张图像生成描述，或者用不同的物理动作集合来实现同一条语言指令。 这种一对多的关系表明，对比式嵌入目标并不合适。

paragraphs.en: While modern approaches do not make such stringent assumptions about how modalities should be united, they still universally encode percepts from all modalities (e.g. text, images) into the same latent space. Intuitively, it would seem that such latent spaces could serve as common conceptual ground across modalities, analogous to a space of human concepts. However, these latent spaces do not cogently capture all information relevant to a concept, and instead rely on modality-specific decoders to flesh out important details. The “meaning” of a percept is not in the vector it is encoded as, but in the way relevant decoders process this vector into meaningful outputs. As long as various encoders and decoders are subject to modality-specific training objectives, “meaning” will be decentralized and potentially inconsistent across modalities, especially as a result of pre-training. This is not a recipe for the formation of coherent concepts.
paragraphs.zh: 虽然现代方法不再对各种模态应如何统一做出如此严格的假设，但它们仍然普遍地将来自所有模态（例如文本、图像）的感知编码到同一个潜在空间中。 直观上看，这样的潜在空间似乎可以充当跨模态的共同概念基础，类似于一个人类概念空间。 然而，这些潜在空间并不能令人信服地捕捉与概念相关的全部信息，而是依赖特定模态的解码器来补充重要的细节。 一个感知的“意义”并不在于它被编码成的向量，而在于相关解码器将该向量处理为有意义输出的方式。 只要各种编码器和解码器受制于特定模态的训练目标，“意义”就会是去中心化的，并且在不同模态之间可能不一致，尤其是预训练所导致的结果。 这并不是形成连贯概念的正确途径。

paragraphs.en: Furthermore, it is not clear that today’s modalities are an appropriate partitioning of the observation and action spaces for an embodied agent. It is not obvious that, e.g., images and text should be represented as separate observation streams, nor text production and motion planning as separate action capabilities. The human capacities for reading, seeing, speaking, and moving are ultimately mediated by overlapping cognitive structures. Making structural assumptions about how modalities ought to be processed is likely to hinder the discovery of more fundamental cognition that is responsible for processing data in all modalities. One solution would be to consolidate unnaturally partitioned modalities into a unified data representation. This would encourage networks to learn intelligent processes that generalize across modalities. Intuitively, a model that can understand the visual world as well as humans can — including everything from human writing to traffic signs to visual art — should not make a serious architectural distinction between images and text. Part of the reason why VLMs can’t, e.g., count the number of letters in a word is because they can’t see what they are writing.
paragraphs.zh: 此外，目前的模态是否是对具身智能体的观察空间和动作空间进行的一种恰当划分，这一点并不清楚。 例如，图像和文本是否应当被表示为独立的观察流，文本生成和运动规划是否应当被表示为独立的动作能力，这些都不是显而易见的。 人类阅读、观看、说话和行动的能力，最终都是由相互重叠的认知结构所中介的。 对模态应当如何被处理做出结构性假设，很可能会阻碍发现更基础的认知，而正是这种认知负责处理所有模态的数据。 一种解决方案是将被不自然划分的模态整合为统一的数据表示。 这将促使网络学习能够跨模态泛化的智能过程。 直觉上说，一个能够像人类一样理解视觉世界的模型——涵盖从人类文字到交通标志再到视觉艺术的一切——不应在图像和文本之间做出重大的架构区分。 视觉语言模型无法做到（例如）数出一个单词中字母的数量，部分原因在于它们看不到自己正在书写的内容。

paragraphs.en: Finally, the learn-from-scale approach trains models to copy the conceptual structure of humans instead of learning the general capability to form novel concepts on their own. Humans have spent hundreds of thousands of years refining concepts and passing them memetically through culture and language. Today’s models are trained only on the end result of this process: the present-day conceptual structures that make it into the corpus. By optimizing for the ultimate products of our intelligence, we have ignored the question of how those products were invented and discovered. Humans have a unique ability to form durable concepts from few examples and ascribe names to them, reason about them analogically, etc. While the in-context capabilities of today’s models can be impressive, they grow increasingly limited as tasks become more complex and stray further from the training data. The flexibility to form new concepts from experience is a foundational attribute of general intelligence , we should think carefully about how it arises.
paragraphs.zh: 最后，「从规模中学习」的路线训练模型去复制人类的概念结构，而不是学习自行形成新概念的通用能力。 人类花了数十万年的时间提炼概念，并通过文化与语言以模因方式将其代代相传。 如今的模型仅在这一过程的最终结果上训练：即那些进入语料库的当代概念结构。 通过针对我们智慧的最终产物进行优化，我们忽略了这些产物是如何被发明和发现的问题。 人类拥有一种独特能力：能从少量样本中形成稳固的概念，为其命名，对其进行类比推理等。 虽然如今模型的上下文内能力可能令人印象深刻，但随着任务变得更加复杂、进一步偏离训练数据，这些能力会越来越受限。 从经验中形成新概念的灵活性是通用智能的一项基础属性，我们应当认真思考它是如何产生的。

paragraphs.en: While structure-agnostic scale maximalism has succeeded in producing LLMs and LVMs that pass Turing tests, a multimodal scale maximalist approach to AGI will not bear similar fruit. Instead of pre-supposing structure in individual modalities, we should design a setting in which modality-specific processing emerges naturally. For example, my recent paper on visual theory of mind saw abstract symbols naturally emerge from communication between image-classifying agents, blurring the lines between text and image processing. Eventually, we should hope to reintegrate as many features of intelligence as possible under the same umbrella . However, it is not clear whether there is genuine commercial viability in such an approach as long as scaling and fine-tuning narrow intelligence models solves commercial use-cases.
paragraphs.zh: 虽然对结构不加区分的规模至上主义已成功产出了能通过图灵测试的大语言模型（LLM）和大视觉模型（LVM），但以多模态的规模至上主义路线通往通用人工智能（AGI）不会结出同样的果实。 我们不应预先假定各模态中的结构，而应设计一种能让模态特定的处理方式自然涌现的环境。 例如，我最近一篇关于视觉心智理论的论文中，抽象符号从负责图像分类的智能体之间的交流中自然涌现，模糊了文本处理与图像处理之间的界限。 最终，我们应期望在同一个框架下重新整合尽可能多的智能特征。 然而，只要通过扩展和微调窄智能模型就能解决商业用例，这种路线是否具有真正的商业可行性尚不明朗。

sents.zh: 然而，只要通过扩展和微调窄智能模型就能解决商业用例，这种路线是否具有真正的商业可行性尚不明朗。

paragraphs.en: The overall promise of scale maximalism is that a Frankenstein AGI can be sewed together using general models of narrow domains. I argue that this is extremely unlikely to yield an AGI that feels complete in its intelligence. If we intend to continue reaping the streamlined efficiency of modality-specific processing, we must be intentional in how modalities are united — ideally drawing from human intuition and classical fields of study, e.g. this work from MIT . Alternatively, we can re-formulate learning as an embodied and interactive process where disparate modalities naturally fuse together. We could do this by, e.g., processing images, text, and video using the same perception system and producing actions for generating text, manipulating objects, and navigating environments using the same action system. What we will lose in efficiency we will gain in flexible cognitive ability.
paragraphs.zh: 规模至上主义的总体承诺是，可以用针对狭窄领域的通用模型拼凑出一个「科学怪人」式的通用人工智能（AGI）。 我认为，这种方式极不可能产生一个在智能上感觉完整的 AGI。 如果我们打算继续获得模态专用处理的高效精简优势，就必须有意识地设计模态的融合方式——最好借鉴人类直觉和经典学科领域，例如 MIT 的这项工作。 或者，我们可以把学习重新表述为一个具身且互动的过程，让不同模态自然地融合在一起。 为此，例如，我们可以用同一个感知系统来处理图像、文本和视频，并用同一个行动系统来产生用于生成文本、操纵物体和在环境中导航的行动。 我们在效率上的损失，将以灵活的认知能力作为回报。

paragraphs.en: In a sense, the most challenging mathematical piece of the AGI puzzle has already been solved: the discovery of universal function approximators. What’s left is to inventory the functions we need and determine how they ought to be arranged into a coherent whole. This is a conceptual problem, not a mathematical one.
paragraphs.zh: 从某种意义上说，AGI 难题中最具挑战性的数学部分已经被解决了：通用函数逼近器的发现。 剩下的工作是盘点我们所需要的函数，并确定应如何将它们组合成一个连贯的整体。 这是一个概念性问题，而不是数学问题。
